visual_identity.core_identity: A squat winged stone predator disguised as architectural sculpture until it begins to move.
visual_identity.silhouette: Broad crouched humanoid body, folded batlike wings, horned head, clawed hands and feet, heavy stone posture.
visual_identity.head_features: Grotesque stone face with short horns, heavy brow, broad nose, fanged mouth, no soft flesh details.
visual_identity.body_shape: Compact muscular humanoid carved from stone, thick forearms, bent legs, folded wings.
visual_identity.surface: Stone planes with a few cracks and chipped edges, not dense masonry texture.
